ADD DISTINCTION ENHANCE YOUR CAPABILITIES
How will your QX60 come to life? Crafted as
a 7-passenger premium crossover, it elegantly
accommodates today’s possibilities. Personalize an
interior as forward-thinking as you. Tailor a space that
adapts to you and your surroundings. Command a
suite of technologies that amplify your abilities as
a driver, enabling you and your passengers to move
forward with a new level of ease.
ENTERTAIN ON THE GO With the Theater Package,1
rear passengers can watch their favorite movies
on large, dual 8-inch headrest monitors — or plug
their favorite game console into the HDMI port and
expand the entertainment options. Even those sitting
in the front can enjoy their own music, separate from
what’s going on behind them.1
RESHAPE VERSATILITY Pioneered in the INFINITI
QX60, a second-row that tilts and slides without
requiring you to remove a child’s seat2 revolutionizes
entry and exit. If your rear passengers need extra
space, the second-row can slide back for an extra
5.5 inches of leg room. Opt for the Sensory and
ProACTIVE Packages1 and you’re a step closer to
ultimate freedom and convenience — especially with
the Motion Activated Liftgate1 that automatically
opens with a swing of your foot under the rear bumper.
INTERIOR COLORS* INTERIOR TRIM*
SEE EVERY SIDE Gain a new perspective on what’s
around you with the Essential Package.1 An INFINITI
world’s first technology, the Around View® Monitor
with Moving Object Detection1,3 and Front and Rear
Sonar System1,4 help you see and maneuver in tight
spaces. Four cameras and one virtual composite 360°
view from above elevate your parking expertise.
BACKUP WITH CONFIDENCE Extend your awareness
when you select either the ProASSIST or ProACTIVE
Package.1 Another INFINITI world’s first technology,
Backup Collision Intervention1,5 alerts you to crossing
traffic and large stationary objects detected when
backing up. The system can even brake before you do
to help avoid a collision. On the road, you have the
ability to sense beyond what you can see with Blind
Spot Intervention,®1,6 an INFINITI world’s first, that uses
rear radar sensors to help detect cars in your blind spot
area and can intervene to help avoid a collision.
